images.note: Real screen capture — Text Box Properties dialog, Action tab, 'Change action options' with all four choices visible under 'Enable as an action': None, Go to report, Go to bookmark, Go to URL (this capture has Go to URL selected, since the source tutorial's topic is Go to URL — used here to show the sibling 'Go to bookmark' option in the same radio group that Lesson 29's bookmark link step uses). Carries only the tutorialgateway.org text copyright watermark ('©tutorialgateway.org') in the corner — no hand-drawn box/circle/arrow/checkmark baked into the image, verified by viewing the full-resolution file.

Real screen capture — same Text Box Properties dialog, Font tab, showing Color set to Blue and Effects set to Underline, with the Sample box previewing blue underlined 'AaBbCc' text. Illustrates manually formatting a bookmark-link text box since SSRS doesn't style it automatically. Only the text copyright watermark present, no drawn marks — verified by viewing the full-resolution file.

Real screen capture — Report Builder's HTML preview viewer rendering a Document Map side pane (tree list: 'Sales Territory with Total Due', 'Sales Territory', 'Sales by Status and Country') next to the rendered AdventureWorks report. Clean capture, no drawn marks, verified by viewing the full-resolution file.

Real screen capture — the same report exported to Excel, showing the document map rendered as its own worksheet ('Sales by Region DM and Bookmarks') with the three entries as blue hyperlinks; the bold border around row 3 is Excel's own active-cell selection highlight, not a drawn annotation. Clean capture, verified by viewing the full-resolution file.

Real screen capture — the same report exported to PDF and opened in a PDF reader, showing the document map rendered as the reader's native Bookmarks pane with the same three entries; the highlighted 'Sales Territory' row is the reader's own selection state, not a drawn annotation. Clean capture, verified by viewing the full-resolution file.

imageSearchNotes: Previous pass (interrupted by a rate limit) had already downloaded 6 candidate images into source-images/ with no corresponding sources.json entries. Every one was viewed at full resolution with the Read tool before any decision. Five had no recorded provenance, so each was re-identified by matching its exact byte size against live candidate URLs found via web search: tutorialgateway.org's 'Go To URL Action in SSRS' article (go-to-url-action-in-ssrs) supplied action-tab-four-types.jpg (= Go-To-URL-Action-8.jpg, 21016 bytes) and link-text-font-format.jpg (= Go-To-URL-Action-9.jpg, 32973 bytes); mssqltips.com tip 3504 'SQL Server Reporting Services Bookmarks and Document Maps' (an exact topical match for this lesson) supplied document-map-pane-rendered.jpg (= 3504_TablixSimpleDocumentMappage1.jpg, 49147 bytes), document-map-excel-worksheet.jpg (= 3504_TablixSimpleDocumentMapExcel.jpg, 27634 bytes), and document-map-pdf-bookmarks.jpg (= 3504_TablixSimpleDocumentMappdf.jpg, 25334 bytes). The sixth leftover, group-properties-menu.jpg, matched tutorialgateway.org's document-map-in-ssrs article (Document-Map-Label-3.jpg, 28401 bytes) and was rejected after a zoomed visual check confirmed a hand-drawn maroon checkmark baked into the image next to 'Group Properties...'. While re-checking the mssqltips.com article's other images for a clean shot of the Bookmark/DocumentMapLabel property field itself, found that most of that article's design-view screenshots (3504_BookMarkProperty.jpg, 3504_Textboxproperties.jpg, 3504_BookMarkResultpage1.jpg, 3504_TablixDocumentMap.jpg) carry the author's own hand-drawn red circled numbers and arrows and were rejected too (see 'skipped'); the Bookmark-property step is instead covered in guide.md prose and the Bookmarks steps slide rather than a screenshot. All five kept images verified via curl -sI (and GET where HEAD was blocked) returning Content-Type: image/jpeg before use.
